edit.description: loop branch: install exit/SIGINT/SIGTERM release before taking either lock
default-lane cover for the held-claim refusal's rollback

summary: Install the loop's exit/SIGINT/SIGTERM release handlers before it takes loop.pid and the tip claim

per.section: The loop lock and the tip claim

acceptance: No point in `flume loop` startup where loop.pid or the tip claim sits on disk with no release handler installed; the rollback on a refused claim has one owner.
pins: flume loop refuses a live-held tip claim and leaves no loop.pid behind
notes: Observed draining INTEGRATION-LANE-WAITS-ARE-EVENT-BASED: handlers install after both locks, so a SIGTERM between them takes node's default disposition and leaves both files. POSIX-only hole, and stale-reclaim (the stated guarantee) still covers it — hence no tests[]: racing a sub-ms window reds flakily, not decidably. Name that exception in the commit body per engineering.md, *A fix ships the test that would have caught it*.

edit.description: read either lane's globs by mode; report awaited timers in spawning cases
the scan's assertion plus its detector-fires fixture

summary: Pin event-based sync points by scan: no case that starts a process awaits a timer, across both lanes

per.section: The default test lane must stay fast

acceptance: The lane scan reads the integration lane's globs as well as the default lane's and reports awaited timers in spawning cases; the suite asserts none over a populated site set.
pins: no case that starts a node process awaits a timer, in either lane
the timer scan reports an awaited timer in a spawning fixture case
notes: Residue from INTEGRATION-LANE-WAITS-ARE-EVENT-BASED: the no-fixed-sleep acceptance was verified by reading. Reuse the existing spawnNames propagation and parameterize the lane mode rather than standing up a second scan (engineering.md, *The fix lands at the mechanism*). Timers inside chain-source string literals are not call sites; friction.test.ts's clock-advance is in no spawning case, so the pin is green on the base.
